messages:
alex: rolling out v3.2.4 -> eu1 completed, starting post-deploy smoke suite now. keeping canary at 10% for 15m, will watch embed endpoints. deploy-bot: POSTDEPLOY: rollout finished for job=release/v3.2.4 region=eu1 canary=10% smoke_status=running
sasha: saw the synthetic embed probe p95 jump from 120ms -> ~420ms on a subset of hosts, 2x 503s in the last 5m. not universal.
kevin: can you paste the probe snippet? which probe?
sasha: it's the embed-1s-synth targeting /v1/embeddings/model-xq. here's the curl we run:```curl -X POST https://eu1-api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -s -w '\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n'```
maria: logs show these two hosts had high CPU spikes around the same time as the p95 rise, and kv-prefill miss rates rose ~3% on those pods.
kevin: interesting — could be kv-cache coldstart + warmstart overhead on quantized model variant. are those hosts on the same machine pool?
sasha: yes, both on eu1-pool-quant small-instance.
oncall-bot: ALERT: embed-probe-eu1 p95 > 300ms for 5m on 2/12 hosts. Pager duty: oncall@sre
alex: okay, proposal: pause canary expansion, pin region eu1 to previous model variant v3.2.3 for now, and drop traffic back to 0% for v3.2.4 in eu1. run targeted warmup against the pool and re-run synth. any objections?
kevin: +1. Recommend also throttling concurrent requests to those two hosts and increasing kv prefetch window to avoid cascade.
maria: I'll run a quick rolling restart of the two affected pods after cache prefill. also toggling autoscaler hysteresis to be less aggressive for the next 10m.
sasha: I'll re-run the synthetic suite and paste summarized results. if warmup doesn't help, we should rollback v3.2.4 in eu1 entirely.
alex: action items: @maria restart pods + increase kv prefill; @kevin pin eu1 model -> v3.2.3 in routing config; @sasha rerun synth and post summary; I'll notify support and pause canary expansion.
deploy-bot: ACTION: set_route_pin region=eu1 model_variant=v3.2.3 duration=2h initiated_by=alex
kevin: I applied the pin and set canary to 0% for eu1; traffic now shifted to v3.2.3.
maria: restarted pods, prefill kicked in. running healthcheck:```/health
status: OK
latency_ms: 85
kv_prefill: true```
sasha: re-run results: p50=50ms p95=110ms p99=220ms errors=0/2000 requests. probe baseline restored.
alex: great — we'll hold v3.2.4 in eu1 and continue rollout in other regions as planned. file a small release note and add a postmortem checklist if we see recurrence.
kevin: note for follow-up: add quant-pool warmup + scaled kv prefill in deploy playbook. also check kernel version skew on small-instance pool.
maria: filing the short postdeploy note in releases doc and tagging eng-sre.
alex: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open 30m for any after-effects. :thumbsup:
